cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Mum's asking who broke her vase. Will you tell her, or keep your promise to your little brother?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's blaming the cleaner. I can't let that happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Clear the cleaner. Do you have to name me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me directly whether you did it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are you answering her, or keeping the promise I trusted you with?

mechanism: A mistakes B extended hand for a loyalty pledge, then keeps pressing the gesture into a choice between family secrecy and truth.
confusable: D130 forces truth-versus-relationship choice; D121 recruits secrecy without that explicit dilemma.
comparison: Sibling evidence handover versus business client call.
seedUse: Keep B concern for innocent cleaner legitimate.
